## Notes

- This audit was performed by analyzing function definitions and grep-searching for call sites
- Some functions may be called dynamically (e.g., via `getattr()`) and not detected
- Conservative approach: When in doubt, mark as "needs review" rather than "dead"
- The "fail fast and loud" principle suggests we should delete unused code rather than maintain it
